description: Delete the 30 redundant per-slice test_self_doc_*.py scanner copies and consolidate their module coverage into a single gate-backed test using scripts/check_self_explaining.py / scripts/self_explaining_comments.py.
goal: Delete all 30 redundant per-slice scanner copy test files in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/ (test_self_doc_cli_package.py, test_self_doc_flow_github_package.py, test_self_doc_root_modules_a.py, test_self_doc_root_modules_b.py, test_self_doc_runners_launcher.py, test_self_doc_src_21.py through test_self_doc_src_28.py, test_self_doc_src_e.py through test_self_doc_src_j.py, test_self_doc_tests_45.py through test_self_doc_tests_51.py, and test_self_doc_tests_a.py through test_self_doc_tests_d.py) while keeping apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_self_doc_modules.py untouched.

Before deleting, collect the exact deduplicated union of every module path pinned across those 30 copies, and create apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_self_doc_gate_coverage.py (staying strictly below 350 lines and NEVER modifying holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json) that: (1) runs scripts.self_explaining_comments.find_comments_and_docstrings over every module in that union so zero enforcement coverage is lost, and (2) asserts no per-slice test_self_doc_src_*.py, test_self_doc_tests_*.py, test_self_doc_cli_package.py, test_self_doc_flow_github_package.py, test_self_doc_root_modules_*.py, or test_self_doc_runners_launcher.py copy remains.

Verify uv run pytest apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_self_doc_gate_coverage.py, full uv run pytest, and uv run task lint pass cleanly. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Per-slice test_self_doc_*.py files duplicate comment/docstring scanning logic across 30 files; consolidating their module coverage into one gate-backed test removes ~2,700 lines of redundant test boilerplate without reducing enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: All 30 redundant per-slice copies (test_self_doc_cli_package.py, test_self_doc_flow_github_package.py, test_self_doc_root_modules_a.py, test_self_doc_root_modules_b.py, test_self_doc_runners_launcher.py, test_self_doc_src_21.py, test_self_doc_src_22.py, test_self_doc_src_23.py, test_self_doc_src_24.py, test_self_doc_src_25.py, test_self_doc_src_26.py, test_self_doc_src_27.py, test_self_doc_src_28.py, test_self_doc_src_e.py, test_self_doc_src_f.py, test_self_doc_src_g.py, test_self_doc_src_h.py, test_self_doc_src_i.py, test_self_doc_src_j.py, test_self_doc_tests_45.py, test_self_doc_tests_46.py, test_self_doc_tests_47.py, test_self_doc_tests_48.py, test_self_doc_tests_49.py, test_self_doc_tests_50.py, test_self_doc_tests_51.py, test_self_doc_tests_a.py, test_self_doc_tests_b.py, test_self_doc_tests_c.py, test_self_doc_tests_d.py) are deleted.

apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_self_doc_gate_coverage.py checks every module previously covered by the 30 deleted copies via scripts.self_explaining_comments.find_comments_and_docstrings and asserts no per-slice scanner copy remains, passing uv run pytest and uv run task lint with no reduction in enforcement and without modifying holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json.
